jobs.description:
Company located in the Roeselare region.

Jobomschrijving

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
	
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse	
• Loading and unloading trucks	
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system	
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)	
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace	
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

	
• You hold a valid forklift certificate	
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• You work accurately and value order and structure	
• Safety is always your top priority	
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

With around 1,000 ‘Brabantians’, we are responsible for the worldwide production, marketing, sales and distribution of our Designed for Living products.

Brabantia has factories in Latvia, China and Belgium. At the Pelt site, we produce not only waste bins, but also bread bins and storage canisters. Adjacent to the production site is our distribution centre, from which Brabantia products are distributed worldwide.

More than 350 employees work at the Pelt site.

Jobomschrijving

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
	
• Manually picking orders	
• Packing and labelling products	
• Processing shipping documents	
• Working with handheld scanners
You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
	
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM	
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs	
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential	
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training	
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport	
• You speak English fluently

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!

• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)	
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)	
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - ERP Project Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a "Domain Lead Supply Chain" for one of its clients.

 

Location : Bruxelles and La Louviére

Start date : October

Duration : 2 years

 

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead and coordinate a major ERP transformation project focused on Supply Chain processes.

The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating the different functional and technical teams involved in the project, with a particular focus on the analysis and design phase.

You will act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, functional analysts, technical teams, key users and external implementation partners. Your role is to ensure that the different teams work towards a common objective, that dependencies are properly managed and that the analysis activities progress according to scope, planning and quality expectations.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing complex ERP projects and is comfortable operating in environments involving multiple stakeholders, parallel workstreams and significant business transformation.

Description

Project management & coordination:

 
• Take ownership of the overall planning and coordination of the ERP project.
 
• Coordinate multiple functional and technical workstreams.
 
• Define and monitor project milestones, deliverables, dependencies and priorities.
 
• Ensure that the different teams remain aligned with the overall project objectives.
 
• Organise and facilitate project meetings, workshops and follow-up sessions.
 
• Monitor progress and proactively identify delays, dependencies, risks and blockers.
 
• Ensure effective communication between business, IT and implementation partners.
 
• Provide regular project status reporting to management and key stakeholders.

 

Coordination of the analysis phase:

 

A major part of the role will be to coordinate and structure the functional analysis activities rather than performing all analysis personally.

 
• Coordinate the functional analysts working on the different Supply Chain processes.
 
• Structure the analysis approach, priorities and deliverables.
 
• Ensure that functional teams have a clear understanding of scope and expected outcomes.
 
• Coordinate workshops with business stakeholders and key users.
 
• Ensure consistency between analyses performed across different processes and teams.
 
• Identify gaps, overlaps and dependencies between functional workstreams.
 
• Challenge proposed solutions where necessary and ensure alignment with the overall ERP strategy.
 
• Track open points, decisions, assumptions and actions resulting from the analysis.
 
• Ensure that functional specifications and process documentation are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

 

Supply chain ERP transformation:

 

The project focuses on the transformation and optimisation of Supply Chain processes within an ERP environment, including areas such as

 
• Procurement and purchasing
 
• Supplier processes
 
• Product and article master data
 
• Inventory and stock management
 
• Warehouse management
 
• Order management
 
• Logistics and delivery processes
 
• End-to-end Supply Chain process flows
 
• Integration with other ERP and business processes

The project manager

does not need to be the deepest functional expert in every area, but must have sufficient ERP and Supply Chain understanding to coordinate experts, challenge decisions and understand project impacts and...

Must have:

• 7+ years of experience in IT Project Management, ideally within ERP transformation projects

• Proven experience coordinating multiple teams and workstreams

• Experience managing projects involving business analysis and functional design

• Strong understanding of ERP environments and Supply Chain processes

• Experience coordinating functional analysts and business stakeholders

• Strong project planning, dependency and risk management skills

• Experience working with external implementation partners

• Strong stakeholder management and communication capabilities

• Ability to challenge functional solutions without necessarily being the hands-on expert

• Experience working in complex transformation environments

• Fluent in French and English

 

Nice to have:

• Experience with large-scale ERP implementations or rollouts

• Previous experience in Supply Chain transformation projects

• Experience with data migration or master data projects

• Experience in Agile, hybrid or Waterfall project environments

• Experience coordinating international teams

 

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.

Kind Regards,

jobs.occupation: Big Water Consulting - Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Python Developer, you will be instrumental in architecting, developing, and maintaining resilient software solutions essential to Clients core business activities. You will work hand-in-hand with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, high-performing applications while fostering the continuous enhancement of technical standards.

Your main assignment will center around the internal monitoring platform, which is dedicated to monitoring and maintaining application health. The internal monitoring facilitates the implementation and management of sophisticated synthetic and log checks for live applications, ensuring timely information about their operational status and coordinating SWIFT notification to relevant personnel whenever intervention is warranted.

At the heart the platform lie the monitoring and alerting engines, both developed in Python, alongside all associated monitoring scripts. Your skills and experience will be pivotal to the ongoing evolution and reliability of this solution.
Key responsibilities

• Collaborate actively to the development and optimization of Python-based software applications.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define software specifications.

• Engage with customers to address service request and ensure effective resolution.

• Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment (CI/CD).

• Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

• Work with DevOps and data engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and performance.

• Ensure security, scalability, and maintainability of solutions.

Key stakeholders:

• Other software development teams

• Product Owners & Business Analysts

• Data Engineers & Architects

• IT Operations

• Business stakeholders

• IT/tech-related academic degree (bachelor's or master's degree.

• 6+ years of experience in Development.

• 3+ years of experience using Python.

• Strong understanding of IT security requirements and their implementation ideally in the context of critical infrastructure

• Proficiency in Python for backend services, preferably with FastAPI or similar frameworks.

• Proficiency with data validation lib as Pydantic.

• Experience with Asyncio.

• Experience in SQL.

• Experience with databases like MSSQL, PostgreSQL.

• Experience with RabbitMQ.

• Strong understanding of service-based architectures and event-driven systems

• Solid conceptual knowledge of software design patterns, scalability, and continuous integration practices

• Knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g Selenium)

• Solid understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to mentor and provide technical leadership.

• Experience working in agile environments.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience with Azure cloud is a plus.

• Experience in NoSQL solutions is a plus.

• Ability to work with legacy code and participate to refactoring initiative.

• Familiarity with containerization using Docker and deployment pipelines in a CI/CD environment is a plus.

• Good level of Dutch and/or French and English is required, German is a plus.
